title: Flows: Generate becomes Queue - a flow frame can stack runs
description: The Flow frame allows exactly ONE run in flight: `_run` returns early on `_running` (MpiBaseFlow.js:3378) and the button morphs Generate -> Cancel (`_syncRunUi`, :3113), so a user cannot fire a second run of the same flow while one is going. The QUEUE underneath already takes them - `submitFlowGeneration` -> `enqueueGeneration` -> `_cueQueue` is the same lane machinery the Gallery Cue uses - so what is single-slot is the frame, not the queue. Make the button queue the run and stay live. Detail, the per-run state to de-singleton and the open UX decisions: brief.md.
